Objects.name: ULSDVOBJ_EIGC_Peer_v1
Objects.description: GNSS compass debug: the last navigation Blitz message decoded from the paired module and the platform solution derived from it

variables.name: peerStatus
variables.description: State of the pairing and of the derived solution

variables.name: peerLid
variables.description: Logical id of the module the last message came from

variables.name: peerSeq
variables.description: Sequence number of the last decoded peer message

variables.name: peerAge
variables.description: Time since the last peer message was decoded

variables.name: peerRate
variables.description: Measured rate peer messages are arriving at

variables.name: peerLost
variables.description: Peer messages missing according to the sequence number

variables.name: peerLat
variables.description: Latitude reported by the peer antenna

variables.name: peerLon
variables.description: Longitude reported by the peer antenna

variables.name: peerHeight
variables.description: Height above mean sea level reported by the peer antenna

variables.name: peerOffset
variables.description: Offset of the peer antenna from the platform centre as the peer reports it (forward,right,down)

variables.name: peerHeading
variables.description: Magnetic heading reported by the peer

variables.name: peerHAcc
variables.description: Horizontal accuracy reported by the peer

variables.name: peerNumSV
variables.description: Satellites used by the peer

variables.name: epochSkew
variables.description: Difference between the peer message iTOW and the local solution it was paired with. A large value means the two fixes are not simultaneous and the baseline will smear when the platform moves

variables.name: baselineNED
variables.description: Vector from this module antenna to the peer antenna in NED frame (N,E,D)

variables.name: baselineLength
variables.description: Measured distance between the two antennas. Compared against baselineNominal to sanity check the pair

variables.name: baselineError
variables.description: Measured baseline minus the configured nominal baseline. The single best indicator that the GNSS compass is healthy

variables.name: baselineHeading
variables.description: True heading of the baseline vector, before the mounting geometry of the two modules is removed

variables.name: baselinePitch
variables.description: Elevation of the baseline vector. Should stay near zero on a level platform and is a useful check on height quality

variables.name: gnssYaw
variables.description: Platform yaw derived from the baseline alone, the GNSS compass output

variables.name: gnssYawAcc
variables.description: Accuracy estimate of the GNSS compass yaw, driven by the position accuracies and the baseline length

variables.name: magYawDelta
variables.description: GNSS compass yaw minus magnetic yaw. Large values point at magnetic disturbance or a wrong declination

variables.name: platformCentreOffsetUsed
variables.description: Offset actually applied to reduce this module fix to the platform centre (forward,right,down)

variables.name: solutionAge
variables.description: Time since the platform solution was last updated

variables.name: rejectCounters
variables.description: Peer messages rejected for: stale epoch, bad peer fix, baseline out of tolerance, missing peer offset
